messages:
Mina (PM): Quick sync — proposing a 'grace tiers' approach for model deprecation/migration that varies by region and embedding schema stability. Need alignment for Q2 roadmap.
Raj (Prod Eng): +1. Can we also tie tiers to hardware buckets (e.g., V100 vs A100) so we don't accidentally swap people onto incompatible quantized variants?
Ellie (Solutions): From the field: EU-regulated customers want no auto-swap within a grace window. Example ask: 90d minimum for finance/legal customers.
Tony (AM): Heads up — two enterprise accounts are asking for 180d custom pins as part of renewals.
Mina (PM): Draft proposal (high-level):
```
- Tier A (standard): 30d notice + auto-swap to compatible variant (same arch, quantized if validated)
- Tier B (regulated/localized): 90d notice + manual migration assistance + opt-in swap
- Tier C (contracted/premium): 180d notice + paid pin + dedicated rollback window
```
Does this cover the common asks? Thoughts on defaults and how we enforce compatibility checks?
Raj (Prod Eng): We need a clear definition of 'compatible variant' in the catalog metadata. I'll propose a compatibility matrix: (arch, tokenizer compat, quantization level, max-seq) and an automated pre-check that rejects swaps if tests fail.
Ellie (Solutions): Also add comm templates: "deprecation notice", "migration steps", and a customer-facing FAQ. Make sure schema/embedding drift notes are clear for localization customers.
Tony (AM): Can we add a short-term escape hatch for customers in active contract negotiations? If we offer 180d pins as a paid add-on, legal will want templated contract language.
Mina (PM): Good call. I'll add 'paid pin' text to the spec and create a small checklist for sales/legal. Next steps: @Raj can you sketch the compatibility matrix and the auto-checks by EOD tomorrow? @Ellie can you draft the comm template? I'll slot this into the Q2 roadmap with dependencies.
Raj (Prod Eng): On it — will post a sketch in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
